register.note: Among APSA’s projects for 2026; no cost or financing published.
register.text: A plant combining solar power with farming in the extraterritorial area of Santa Maria di Galeria, near Rome, where the Vatican Radio transmission centre stands. A memorandum of understanding signed on 10 June 2026 by the Governorate of Vatican City State, APSA, the Fondazione Fratello Sole and ACEA sets out a joint path to define, structure and progressively implement it, to power the radio station and meet the full energy needs of Vatican City State, with the surplus left to Italy. It serves the energy standard; no cost or financing has been published.
